AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Storage of Crop Produce? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Storage of Crop Produce.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Storage of Crop Produce.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Storage of Crop Produce.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Storage of Crop Produce.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Animal Feed: Hay? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.

   A. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

19. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Leftover Food? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Leftover Food.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Leftover Food.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Leftover Food.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Leftover Food.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
